theorems.name: Submission.p04_tz91_invariant_restriction_norm_range
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H], ∃ j : A.ρ.invariants →ₗ[k] (Rep.res H.subtype A).ρ.invariants, (∀ a : A.ρ.invariants, (j a : A) = (a : A)) ∧ LinearMap.range A.ρ.normBar ≤ (LinearMap.range (Rep.res H.subtype A).ρ.normBar).comap j
theorems.natural_summary: The invariant inclusion preserves underlying vectors. A right-transversal sum provides a subgroup-norm preimage for every ambient norm.
